poema.texto:
Title: Zéjel (Forma)

In the heart's labyrinth, where shadows dwell, (a)
A form emerges, as if from a spell. (a)

An abstract dance, without beginning or end, (b)
On its canvas, emotions blend. (b)

Invisible threads weave, in endless twirl, (b)
Connecting dreams and feelings swirl. (b)

A form takes shape, born of deep sorrow, (c)
Its beauty, a reflection of tomorrow. (c)

From the chaos, order unfolds, (c)
In the heart's secret chambers, it's told. (c)

Thus, within us, art forms anew, (c)
A testament to love's endless hue. (c)
